text:
samir: Summarizing postmortem follow-ups so we can convert them into concrete tests/tickets.
liz_w: Thanks. Short list of root causes?
samir: (1) KV eviction lag under burst QPS, (2) model fallback tokenization mismatch on quantized builds, (3) prompt canonicalization bug in caching layer, (4) autoscaler pacing causing transient cold starts.
ian_k: I can pick up KV eviction coverage: add a chaos attack + a sustained 10min ramp load. Will add a lightweight regression that runs in CI smoke.
liz_w: I'll own the quantized vs full deterministic eval. Plan: 250 paired prompts, fixed seed, temperature=0, compare token-level diffs and sequence-level fidelity. Gate if token-diff > 1.2%.
samir: Prompt fix: add unit tests for canonicalization and a small incident-derived promptset (60 examples) to the eval repo. Owner: samir.
ian_k: Proposed chaos snippet to iterate in the harness:
```
chaosctl run --attack=kv-evict-burst --pool=serving-main --rps=0:800:15m --duration=20m --collect-metrics=latency,cache-miss
```
ian_k: We'll capture eviction lag histogram + failed-cache rate.
ci-bot: Reminder: add CI job `eval/quant-check` and `chaos/kv-smoke` to staging pipeline.
liz_w: Timeline suggestions:
- KV chaos smoke + artifacts: 48h (owner: ian_k)
- Quantized-vs-full eval PR + nightly job: 4d (owner: liz_w)
- Promptset PR + unit tests: 3d (owner: samir)
- Autoscaler soak added to weekly stress matrix: 1wk (owner: infra-team)
samir: We'll store promptset at eng-ml/evals/promptsets/incident-2026-11-evict for traceability.
ian_k: Also proposing to tag the new load profile `burst-800-15m` and include it in the monthly targeted soak runs since we've seen ~monthly recurrences.
ci-bot: When quant eval runs exceed gate, auto-open issue with label `eval/regression` and post summary to #eng-ml-evals.
liz_w: Good. I'll implement the GitHub Action that runs the eval nightly for one week after merge and posts the JSON summary to the channel.
samir: Action checklist I'll add to the follow-up ticket: 
- [ ] KV chaos smoke uploaded (ian_k)
- [ ] Promptset committed (samir)
- [ ] Quant eval CI job (liz_w)
- [ ] Autoscaler soak added to matrix (infra-team)
- [ ] Rollout checklist updated with auto-rollback guard (sre)
ops-bot: Follow-up ticket created: INF-2107. Linking postmortem and assigning owners. Due dates: 48h for smoke, 1 week for full coverage.
ian_k: Starting KV smoke now, will post traces when done.
liz_w: Draft PR for quant eval by Monday. Will include deterministic seed and raw artifacts.
samir: Promptset curation in progress; pulling high-variance requests and edge cases from traces. PR by Thu.
ci-bot: Note: add `burst-800-15m` to weekly staging soak and make it runnable as a one-off for oncall.
samir: Please post short status updates back into this thread as items land so we can close INF-2107. Thanks all :thumbsup:
